# AL1306: Avoid SQL string interpolation in CommandText

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `Reliability` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Al1306SqlInterpolationInCommandTextAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

String interpolation in SQL CommandText can lead to SQL injection vulnerabilities. Use parameterized queries with placeholders ($1, @param) instead of interpolating values directly.
